text: Long enough that the committee that's ignored this grid for eleven years would have to read about it. Nobody hurt.
style: A grid engineer in her early thirties who helped build tonight's outage believing nobody would be hurt, and has just read otherwise. Consistent Californian American accent with Mexican-American Spanish inflection throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Mid-range pitch. Frightened and entirely competent at the same time: the technical sentences come out steady and fast, the ones about herself do not.
